help.title: How it works
help.start.title: Getting started
help.start.body:
Choose a mode on the home screen: one shared bank for the whole table, or a wallet on every player's phone.
Set the starting money and the GO salary (classic rules: 1,500 and 200).
Pick your game edition (currency, starting money, GO salary) and change anything that differs on your box. Save it as your own edition to reuse it next time.
help.shared.title: One shared bank
help.shared.body:
Every player has a title deed card with their balance.
GO pays the salary. Pay sends money from that player, Get gives them money (from the bank by default). In the payment window you can pick any payer and receiver, including the Free Parking pot.
Made a mistake? Tap Undo in the message or in History.
help.wallet.title: Wallet per player
help.wallet.body:
One player starts the game and shows the invite QR code. Everyone else taps “Join game” and scans it.
Each player enters their own payments from and to the bank on their own phone.
help.transfer.title: Paying another player
help.transfer.body:
The payer taps “Pay a player”, enters the amount and shows the QR code.
The receiver taps “Receive” and scans it. Each code works only once and only in your game.
No camera? Type the 12-character code instead.
help.offline.title: Offline & install
help.offline.body:
After the first visit the app works without internet. Install it to your home screen from Settings for the best experience.
Everything is saved on the device automatically, so you can close the app and continue later.
help.privacy.title: Privacy
help.privacy.body: No accounts, no tracking, no game data leaves your device. When online, the app sends one empty ping at start so the author can see how often it is used.
